mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM team_analyses ta JOIN analyses a ON a.id = ta.analysis_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ta.team_id = #{teamId} AND ta.analysis_id = #{analysisId} FOR SHARE OF ta
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_challenges c JOIN analyses a ON a.id = c.analysis_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_challenges (team_id, analysis_id, start_date, end_date, target_rate, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{analysisId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{targetRate}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.analysis_id, a.title, a.project_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.target_rate, c.created_at FROM team_challenges c JOIN analyses a ON a.id = c.analysis_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT challenge_id, user_id, attempt_id, score, total, created_at FROM ( SELECT c.id AS challenge_id, qa.user_id, qa.id AS attempt_id, qa.score, qa.total, qa.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id, qa.user_id ORDER BY qa.created_at DESC, qa.id DESC) AS rn FROM team_challenges c JOIN analyses a ON a.id = c.analysis_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN quizzes z ON z.analysis_id = c.analysis_id JOIN quiz_attempts qa ON qa.quiz_id = z.id AND qa.created_at >= c.start_date AND qa.created_at < c.end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY JOIN team_members tm ON tm.team_id = c.team_id AND tm.user_id = qa.user_id
) latest WHERE rn = 1
